text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Happy Meek's talent began to bloom, 
Trainer Kiryuin was having fulfilling 
days, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One night, Happy Meek collapses and is 
rushed to the infirmary, causing quite a 
stir. The cause turned out to be extreme 
exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The joy of finally being able to run 
again. And the desire she had held back 
all this timeâ her wish to "celebrate 
together with Trainer"â

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to contain those feelings, Happy 
Meek went and trained on her own without 
telling Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin felt deeply discouraged 
and voiced her weaknesses, lamenting that 
despite always being by Happy Meek's side, 
she hadn't truly been watching over her 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Godolphin Barb cited past 
Umamusume to explain that Kiryuin was the 
only true partner for Happy Meek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The history left behind by Umamusume who 
trusted their Trainers— To become such a 
Trainer, Kiryuin decides to answer Happy 
Meek's feelings.
